About Evergreen Outdoor Co.

Your outdoor space should fit the way you live. Evergreen Outdoor Co. is a fictional Portland-area concept showing how a landscaping business can help homeowners plan a welcoming yard, keep it healthy, and make seasonal upkeep easier.

A simple path to a better outdoor space

  1. Share how you use your yard, what is not working, and the look or function you want to create.
  2. Review the site conditions, planting preferences, maintenance needs, and practical design options.
  3. Agree on a clear scope, materials, schedule, and care plan before work begins.

Outdoor Services, Thoughtfully Planned

  • Landscape Design & Installation

    Shape a front or back yard around your property, preferred style, sun exposure, soil conditions, and how you want to use the space. A practical design considers both the initial installation and future upkeep.

  • Lawn Care & Grounds Maintenance

    Keep grass, edges, and shared outdoor areas tidy with a care schedule suited to the site, turf type, and growing conditions. Service frequency should reflect the season and actual property needs.

  • Garden Refresh & Planting

    Refresh planting beds with suitable shrubs, flowers, mulch, and edging. Plant selection should consider local climate, mature size, sunlight, soil, and water requirements.

  • Seasonal Maintenance & Irrigation

    Plan seasonal cleanups, pruning, irrigation checks, and water-conscious adjustments. Local restrictions and plant needs should guide watering schedules and system choices.

  • Shower & Fixture Installation

    Replace faucets, showerheads, and other kitchen or bathroom fixtures.

Frequently Asked Questions

What should I share when requesting a landscaping estimate?

Share your address or service area, the areas you want to improve, your main goals, and any timing or budget considerations. Photos of the yard can help explain the project.

Can landscaping include both design and ongoing maintenance?

A landscaping provider may offer design, installation, lawn care, garden-bed upkeep, irrigation, and seasonal maintenance. Confirm the actual services available in your area.

How do I choose plants for my yard?

Plant choices should reflect local climate, sunlight, soil, drainage, mature size, and maintenance preferences. A site assessment helps avoid choosing plants that do not suit the conditions.

How often should a lawn or garden be maintained?

It depends on the grass and plant types, season, weather, irrigation, and the appearance you want. A provider can recommend a schedule after reviewing the property.

Is Evergreen Outdoor Co. a real landscaping company?

No. Evergreen Outdoor Co. is a fictional portfolio website concept using Portland, Oregon as an example market. The brand, phone number, service area, and business details are placeholders.
